title: Norway's GPFG ethics-framework committee delivers its report to the Ministry of Finance
source: EST: the committee's own official website, nettsteder.regjeringen.no/uerspu/ ('Utvalg som skal vurdere det etiske rammeverket for Statens pensjonsfond utland'), fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200 — note this subdomain is reachable while regjeringen.no itself returned a Cloudflare HTTP 403 to WebFetch and to curl with three browser user-agents on the same day). Its /mandat/ page states the deadline verbatim: 'Utvalget skal levere sin utredning innen 15. oktober 2026' (the front page says 'sin rapport'), and adds 'Utvalget skal folge utredningsinstruksen' — so the deliverable is an NOU that goes to public horing after delivery. It gives the committee's mandate as 'vurdere og foresla eventuelle endringer i det etiske rammeverket og relevante deler av den ansvarlige forvaltningen av pensjonsfondet' and its appointment as 7 November 2025. CHAIR CORRECTED 2026-09-06 (initial research): this entry previously named Aslak Skancke as chair, which was a misreading — Skancke is the site's 'ansvarlig redaktor' (responsible editor, contact postmottak@etikkradet.no), a footer role on every page. The /medlemmer/ page names the utvalgsleder as SVEIN GJEDREM, with members Annie Bersagel, Alexander Wright Cappelen, Marius Emberland, Gunhild Hoogensen Gjorv, Hanne Eggen Roislien, Arthur Sletteberg, Ulf Sverdrup and Karen Helene Ulltveit-Moe (who also chairs the Ekspertradet behind norway-gpfg-bond-expert-group-2027-01-25). Norwegian press calls it the Gjedrem-utvalget. Independently corroborated by the Storting's own Innst. 418 S (2025-2026) (stortinget.no, fetched direct 2026-09-06, HTTP 200), which records that 'et nedsatt utvalg legger frem innen 15. oktober 2026'. Filed estimate on three counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a Norwegian government-appointed committee's own site, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the date is a stated delivery deadline for a report rather than a scheduled publication with a time
notes: Discovered during the norway-gpfg-bond-expert-group-2027-01-25 initial research (2026-09-06), which was mapping the dated nodes in Norway's GPFG governance calendar. This is the OTHER Ministry-commissioned review running in parallel with the bond-strategy work, and it is a different body from the Ekspertradet: a committee set up 2025-11-07 under chair Svein Gjedrem, reviewing the fund's ethical framework and the observation/exclusion guidelines. LOW impact CONFIRMED by initial research 2026-09-06 (docs/research/events/norway-gpfg-ethics-committee-2026-10-15.md) — the tier now rests on measurement rather than absence of evidence, and the naive read of this event has the wrong sign. Three findings. (1) The exclusion mechanism is ALREADY SUSPENDED: following Stortingets vedtak 4 November 2025 the Ministry repealed the observation/exclusion guidelines and replaced them with temporary ones by letter of 2025-11-07; Etikkradet sends no tilradinger, and NBIM states 'Norges Bank shall not decide on observation or exclusion, but may revoke previous decisions' (nbim.no, HTTP 200). The list update of 2026-08-11 removed four names and added none — the mechanism runs one way, inward, until a new framework is adopted. (2) The base rate is null and structural: the one clean US large-cap exclusion, Caterpillar (published 2025-08-25), closed at -0.33% excess vs SPY, the 20th percentile of its own trailing-60 daily excess, and is +90.0% vs SPY +21.2% since, still excluded — because Norges Bank publishes a name only 'once the divestment is completed' (its letter of 2025-08-18), so the flow finishes before the print. (3) The mandate's direction of travel is NARROWING: it warns that if the fund 'cannot be invested in the world's largest companies' it becomes harder to remain a global index fund, and singles out large tech companies' dual-use software as the hardest line to draw. No tracked name (AAPL/AMZN/MSFT/META/AVGO/MRVL/CRWV) is on the exclusion list. Clock: the deliverable is an NOU under the utredningsinstruksen; on the Mestad precedent (NOU 2020:7 delivered 2020-06-15 -> horing 2020-10-20 -> Meld. St. 24 (2020-2021) 2021-04-09 -> guidelines revised 2021) nothing is in force before H2 2027 at the earliest. Read alongside norway-gpfg-bond-expert-group-2027-01-25, the bond-side node in the same chain, with which it shares a member (Ulltveit-Moe).
